name: text-field
title: Text Field
description: Materialize text inputs with a floating label, prefix icon, helper and error text, character counter and an outlined variant.
improvements: The floating label is pure CSS (:placeholder-shown, :focus, :autofill), so autofilled and programmatically set values never overlap it. No M.updateTextFields().
Label, helper text, error message and counter are wired with id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid; error messages are announced.
The character counter announces politely after typing pauses instead of on every keystroke.
Opt-in validate uses :user-invalid, so fields only turn red after the user has interacted.
New outlined variant, and shared building blocks reused by Textarea, Select, Autocomplete and Chips.
